mapper.select: select ma.inst_id, i.inst_name, ma.dept_id, d.dept_name, ma.complain_category_id, cc.category_name, ma.account_id, a.login_id, u.user_name, ma.del_yn from t1500_manager_assignment ma join t1000_institution i on i.inst_id = ma.inst_id join t1000_department d on d.dept_id = ma.dept_id join t2000_complain_category cc on cc.complain_category_id = ma.complain_category_id join t1000_account a on a.account_id = ma.account_id join t1000_user u on u.user_no = a.user_no order by ma.create_dt DESC, ma.update_dt DESC

select ma.inst_id, i.inst_name, ma.dept_id, d.dept_name, ma.complain_category_id, cc.category_name, ma.account_id, a.login_id, u.user_name, ma.del_yn, TO_CHAR(ma.create_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS create_dt, TO_CHAR(ma.update_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS update_dt from t1500_manager_assignment ma join t1000_institution i on i.inst_id = ma.inst_id join t1000_department d on d.dept_id = ma.dept_id join t2000_complain_category cc on cc.complain_category_id = ma.complain_category_id join t1000_account a on a.account_id = ma.account_id join t1000_user u on u.user_no = a.user_no where i.inst_id=#{instId} AND d.dept_id=#{deptId} AND cc.complain_category_id=#{complainCategoryId} AND a.account_id=#{accountId}
mapper.insert: insert into t1500_manager_assignment(inst_id, dept_id, complain_category_id, account_id, create_id, create_dt) values (#{instId}, #{deptId}, #{complainCategoryId}, #{accountId}, #{createId}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT account_id FROM ( SELECT ma.account_id, COUNT(c.complain_id) AS open_cnt FROM t1500_manager_assignment ma LEFT JOIN t2000_complain c ON c.account_id = ma.account_id AND c.complain_category_id = ma.complain_category_id AND c.complain_status_cd IN ('D001','D002','D003') WHERE ma.complain_category_id = #{complainCategoryId} AND ma.del_yn = 'N' GROUP BY ma.account_id ORDER BY open_cnt ASC, dbms_random.value ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT ma.inst_id, ma.dept_id, ma.complain_category_id, ma.account_id,
i.inst_name, d.dept_name, cc.category_name, a.login_id, u.user_name,
ma.del_yn AS delYn, TO_CHAR(ma.create_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createDt, TO_CHAR(ma.update_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS updateDt FROM t1500_manager_assignment ma JOIN t1000_institution i ON i.inst_id = ma.inst_id JOIN t1000_department d ON d.dept_id = ma.dept_id JOIN t2000_complain_category cc ON cc.complain_category_id = ma.complain_category_id JOIN t1000_account a ON a.account_id = ma.account_id JOIN t1000_user u ON u.user_no = a.user_no
AND ma.del_yn = #{delYn}
AND ma.dept_id = #{deptId}
AND ma.complain_category_id = #{complainCategoryId}
AND ma.account_id = #{accountId}
AND i.inst_name LIKE '%' || #{instName} || '%'
AND d.dept_name LIKE '%' || #{deptName} || '%'
AND cc.category_name LIKE '%' || #{categoryName} || '%'
AND a.login_id LIKE '%' || #{loginId} || '%'
AND u.user_name LIKE '%' || #{userName} || '%'
AND ma.create_dt >= TO_DATE(#{createDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ma.create_dt < TO_DATE(#{updateDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND ma.update_dt >= TO_DATE(#{createDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ma.update_dt < TO_DATE(#{updateDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
ORDER BY ma.create_dt DESC, ma.update_dt DESC, ma.inst_id DESC ORDER BY ma.update_dt DESC, ma.create_dt DESC, ma.inst_id DESC ORDER BY ma.create_dt DESC, ma.update_dt DESC, ma.inst_id DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
